title: GenerationVersion
description: The text a generation held at one point in its life. Kept as its own record so editing a generation never loses what it said before — the generation carries the current text, the versions carry the ones it had.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The generation this is a version of, by its id in the system that holds it.

version.description: Which version this is, counting up within the generation. Ordering is the number's job; whether it may skip or repeat is the writing system's rule.

output.description: The text as it stood in this version.
